_comment: Ground truth for tests/fixtures/nrl_pur1011848.pdf (NRL works tender PUR1011848 'Piping and other ancillary work of EBMS blending system', 85 pages, digital text layer, no PDF bookmarks, pages 84-85 are drawings with no text apart from the footer). Pages are 1-based PHYSICAL; printed 'Tender: PUR1011848 Page X of 85' matches physical (offset 0). Note the SOR annexure carries its OWN 'SOR Page X of 10' footer on pages 59-68 - the printed-page detector must ignore it (its N != document page count). Verified by hand against the PDF on 2026-10-15. Do NOT edit to make a test pass.

targets._comment: The five labels the business asked for. Resolved to the SHALLOWEST section whose title or index description maps to the label. SCC/SOR/Tech Specs are annexures 20/19/21 here, not top-level sections. Deeper matches ('2. Technical Specification:' on p83, '18. Schedule of Rates' on p74, both inside annexures) must NOT win.

_flat_comment: flat_inclusive: parent range covers children. flat_exclusive: parent stops before its first child. Leaves identical.

tree_levels._comment: Level-1 headings here have NO letter prefix - they are recognised through the label vocabulary ('titled' kind). Annexures nest under annexure_list. Annexure 7.2/7.2.1 are orphans (no Annexure 7) and keep nominal levels 3/4.

annexure_titles_from_body._comment: For a bare 'Annexure N' line the title is the largest emphasized line group below it on the same page. Note the typo in the source on p69.

_missing_comment: Annexure 17 is listed as applicable on p17 with an EMPTY description and never appears in the body. This must produce a warning but must NOT trigger the whole-document LLM fallback (one missing non-target id with no description = informational).
boilerplate_lines_expected: Piping and other ancillary work of EBMS blending system in Numaligarh Refinery Marketing
_boilerplate_comment: 'SPECIAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT' is a running header on pp71-78 (11pt bold, y~0.04) and 'Technical Tender Document' on pp80-83. Both match the label vocabulary and must still be stripped (vocabulary matches are NOT exempt from boilerplate; only letter/named structural headings are). The section starts are the 'Annexure 20' / 'Annexure 21' lines on pp69/79, so stripping loses nothing here.
